1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pindaan) 2019.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 31 Mei 2019.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989], yang disebut

"Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam Jadual dengan memasukkan selepas

butiran 18 butiran yang berikut:

"19. Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pesisiran Pantai

Barat (Taiping-Banting) yang bermula dari kilometer 146.27

di Persimpangan Bertingkat Hutan Melintang di koordinat

U 423983.673, T 334021.534 Grid Bentuk Benar Serong

di Tepi (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer

158.40 di Persimpangan Bertingkat Teluk Intan di koordinat

U 435796.871, T 333514.926 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000)

arah utara dan arah selatan.".

Peta

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Amendment)

Order 2019.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 31 May 2019.

Amendment of Schedule

2. The National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989], which is referred to as

the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in the Schedule by inserting after item 18

the following item:

"19. The part of the road known as the West Coast Expressway

(Taiping-Banting) commencing from kilometre 146.27 at Hutan

Melintang Interchange at coordinates N 423983.673, E 334021.534 of

the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

and ending at kilometre 158.40 at Teluk Intan Interchange at

coordinates N 435796.871, E 333514.926 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid north bound and south bound.".

Map
